article.hook: You show up early and stay late. The Sun moves into Capricorn, turning the spotlight on what you’re willing to carry until it’s done.
article.lived: For about a month, daily life feels like a slow climb. We catch ourselves rewriting emails for the third time, scheduling meetings no one wants but everyone needs, and holding the weight of unfinished business like a promise to the future. The small, exacting acts of responsibility stretch across weeks and shape what we’ll be measured by later.
article.turn: The problem starts when the climb becomes the whole view. You work the hours that erase your evening, correct the same mistake twice because you can’t delegate, and hold your worth hostage to what’s checked off. Mastery becomes a cage when the climb is all you see.
moves: Send the email you’ve been rewriting for three days without another edit.
Say no to one task that doesn’t fit your long game.
Schedule a meeting to delegate, not just report.

judge.weakest: The small, exacting acts of responsibility stretch across weeks and shape what we’ll be measured by later.
judge.why: Strong hook, lived, and turn focused on observable behavior; moves are concrete and specific; the article could only be Sun in Capricorn.
